info.text:
Stripe takes $1.75 from a $50 sale. Most of it isn't Stripe's.
Our math: Stripe's standard US card fee of 2.9% + 30¢ on $50 = $1.75.
Visa and Mastercard credit swipe fees averaged 2.35% in 2024 (Nilson Report): about $1.18, mostly to the card-issuing bank.
Big-bank debit interchange averaged about 22-24¢ in 2023 (Federal Reserve), so Stripe keeps more on debit at the same price.
Payments on Stripe grew from $817B in 2022 to $1.9T in 2025, up 34% that year (Stripe annual letters).
Sources: Stripe pricing and annual letters; Nilson Report via NACS; Federal Reserve Regulation II data.
News and education, not financial advice.
